notes.title: Santa is coming to the tournament!
notes.content:
Happy holidays!

We are happy to announce the beginning of Spell Swap's Christmas event. Grab your warmest wizard robes and join the battle!

The event features :

- Temporary Christmas themed decors and visual effects.
--> It's here for the holidays and will disappear after the festivities. Enjoy it while it's there!

- Santa Wizard skin.
--> Santa is joining the battle, but without any gifts..! This wizard skin will stay in-game even after the event.

- New modifiers.
--> Experiment with two new modifiers : Blizzard and The Floor Is Lava. Have fun! These modifiers are here to stay too.

- Quality of Life changes.
--> See the patch notes for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307678/5793755a8d2c014265111364d880c6c5de047e1e.png[/img]

tags.feature: - Temporary Christmas themed decors and visual effects.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes for the 1.2.0 update.

- Temporary Christmas themed decors and visual effects. 
--> Will be removed at the end of the Christmas event.

- New Santa wizard skin.
--> Permanent addition to the skin list!

- New Blizzard modifier.
--> A strong and cold wind is blowing! It will push players and spells in the arena. It can change direction over time.

- New The Floor Is Lava modifier.
--> Do not touch the ground! The more you stay on the ground, the more damage you take. So do not stop jumping!

- Player name change.
--> You can now click on a player name in the Character Selection screen to edit it. Type whatever you want! The random names on new player creation are still there.

tags.feature: - Temporary Christmas themed decors and visual effects.
- New The Floor Is Lava modifier.

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307678/2080ad1b4737012c629d7031786fef4dd1080002.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween is here![/h1]

Celebrate Halloween in Spell Swap with a new wizard : [b]Jack'O Lantern[/b].

For the occasion, we decorated ALL the arenas with Halloween themed items! We even changed the visual ambience for something... darker and spookier...

The new wizard is here to stay, however the spooky decors will disappear in two weeks!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307678/a13e1ef5b0c533f0f513fa7104bae22e67b106eb.png[/img]

[h2]Hey there Swappers! We released update 1.1! It contains a lot of balance changes.
[/h2]
Here are the patch notes :

[h3]SPELL BALANCE[/h3]

- Pocket Black Hole
--> Increased range.
--> Attracts players and projectiles toward the caster.

- Arrow + Arrow Rain
--> Increased visual effects size.

- Arrow Rain
--> Now fires at a 45° angle instead of upward.

- Confetti Burst
--> Increased range.
--> Greatly increased knockback force.
--> The mega variant now has a way bigger range.

- Shard Burst
--> Increased projectiles lifetime.
--> Added a powerfull knockback on the caster.

- Meteor Shower
--> Now only casts one huge and deadly meteor.
--> Increased damage. Added the possibility to direct hit.

- Radiance + Molotov
--> Reduced burning area duration.
--> Greatly increased damages per second.

[h3]ARENA REWORK[/h3]

- Botomless Pit
--> Full rework of the arena. We added a really huge pit!

- Floating Island
--> Full rework of the arena. It's now the biggest level in the game!

- Small Ditch
--> Increased the size of the arena. It now has more platforms and an underground tunnel.

- Pinball Pit
--> Added tunnels around the arena. The Shart Burst spell is deadly in this one.

[h3]FIXES[/h3]

- Enhanced cooldown feedback. It applies to both parry and spell cooldowns.

- Changed Molotov's icon for easier reading.

- Added more visual effects to the Bubble spell.

- The Crown in the Keep The Crown gamemode will now navigate the arena instead of teleporting.

- Some graphical effects are now disabled on game end and in the pause menu.

- Various minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- The team mode now works as intended.
- The leaderboards are now fixed. Scoring system is now more fair.
- We saw some reports of players being able to play outside of their turn during the "Turn Based" mode. It is now fixed.
- Fixed a bug that allowed some players to start a new game with their last game' spell when playing in the "Swap On Kill" mode.
- Fixed a bug that made the game crash when finishing a game just when the "No Platforms" announce was made in the "TV Show" mode.
- Fixed some presets that weren't setting the correct game mode.
- The "Justice Hammer" is now more fair : it will correctly target the best player in ALL cases. (We fired the previous judge, he wasn't impartial...)
- Various minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
We received feedback about some very specific controller related issues. Here are the patch notes of what we fixed in the last update:

- Fixed multiple controllers being able to move the mouse cursor
- Changed the default values for some gamemodes
- Updated default keyboard bindings

Don't forget to restart Steam if you do not receive the update!
